title: Anomaly.Comm.Line
description: Event (module Anomaly.Comm): one per chat line delivered to the receiver, never anyone else's (A.7). An event, not a snapshot: two identical lines are two events, nothing is deduplicated, and nothing is replayed on refresh, re-subscription or Anomaly.Request. The text line is still sent as today; a client routes ONE of the two into chat history and triggers. from is null for an unseen speaker (shown as Someone in the text); to is the receiver for a telepath, the gang for gangpath, else null.
